name: Message in a Bottle
label: Quest
description: A washed-up bottle found along the shores of Stranglethorn Vale holds an urgent plea for rescue. Its author claims to be held prisoner by a great beast…
intro: A washed-up bottle found along the shores of Stranglethorn Vale holds an urgent plea for rescue. Its author claims to be held prisoner by a great beast on an isolated island in the South Seas.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The note reads, in fairly good handwriting:
To any that can aid me-
Please, my need for help is dire. A great Skymane holds me captive on an island in the South Seas.
The stars at night are foreign to me and obscured by the jungle trees, but on the clearest days I see Wild Shore to the northwest, and what seem to be large sailing ships to the southwest.
I beg of you, my would-be savior, please help me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Have you come to free me?
